### From `packages/core/src/approvals.ts`

#### <a id="core-approvalpreview"></a>`ApprovalPreview`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/approvals.ts`

What a run would do, worked out before it is approved.

```ts
type ApprovalPreview = {
  title: string;
  parts: ({
    type: "text";
    text: string;
  } | {
    type: "code";
    language: string;
    code: string;
    title?: string | undefined;
  } | {
    type: "table";
    title: string;
    table: {
      columns: {
        name: string;
        kind: "number" | "boolean" | "date" | "text" | "integer" | "datetime" | "time" | "uuid" | "json" | "binary";
        nullable: boolean;
        label?: string | undefined;
        type?: TypeDef<any> | undefined;
        ref?: `${string}/${string}` | undefined;
        role?: "group" | "measure" | "attribute" | undefined;
        key?: boolean | undefined;
        editable?: boolean | undefined;
      }[];
      rows: z.core.util.JSONType[][];
      offset: number;
      truncated: boolean;
      sort: {
        column: string;
        dir: "asc" | "desc";
      }[];
      limit?: number | undefined;
      total?: number | undefined;
      write?: {
        affected: number;
      } | undefined;
      records?: {
        type: `${string}/${string}`;
        id: string;
      } | undefined;
    };
  } | {
    type: "type-diff";
    name: string;
    changes: string[];
    breaks: {
      fn: string;
      why: string;
    }[];
    before?: TypeDef<any> | undefined;
    after?: TypeDef<any> | undefined;
  } | {
    type: "flags";
    flags: {
      path: string;
      kind: "key" | "token" | "gitignored" | "env" | "credential" | "secret-content";
      rule: string;
      access: "write" | "read";
      action: "ask" | "refuse" | "allow";
      why: string;
      certain: boolean;
    }[];
  })[];
  irreversible: boolean;
  subject?: {
    kind: "system-install";
    system: SystemName;
    instance: InstanceName;
    version: string;
    manifestHash: string;
    bundleHash: string;
    sourceHash: string;
    host: {
      system: SystemName;
      instance: InstanceName;
    };
    source?: string | undefined;
    grants?: {
      hub: ("search" | "embed" | "fns" | "settings" | "state" | "resources" | "approvals" | "connections" | "data" | "ai" | "decide")[];
      models?: {
        roles?: ("ocr" | "chat" | "transcribe" | "dictate" | "speak" | "describe")[] | undefined;
        models?: string[] | undefined;
        perRun?: number | undefined;
        perDay?: number | undefined;
      } | undefined;
      secrets?: string[] | undefined;
      calls?: (`${string}/${string}` | SystemName)[] | undefined;
      network?: string[] | undefined;
      files?: {
        read: string[];
        write: string[];
      } | undefined;
    } | undefined;
    replaces?: {
      version: string;
      manifestHash: string;
    } | undefined;
  } | undefined;
  checks?: {
    scan: {
      size: number;
      builtins: string[];
      concerns: {
        kind: "builtin" | "dynamic-import" | "dynamic-require" | "eval" | "new-function";
        line: number;
        detail: string;
        code: string;
      }[];
      urls: string[];
      hosts: string[];
    };
    tests?: {
      system: SystemName;
      version: string;
      ranAt: number;
      duration: number;
      passed: number;
      failed: number;
      skipped: number;
      cases: {
        file: string;
        name: string;
        status: "failed" | "skipped" | "passed";
        duration: number;
        real?: boolean | undefined;
        error?: string | undefined;
      }[];
      more?: number | undefined;
      previews?: {
        component: string;
        state: string;
        viewport: "phone" | "desktop";
        theme: "light" | "dark";
        image: {
          hash: string;
          size: number;
          mime: string;
        };
      }[] | undefined;
    } | undefined;
  } | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-fnapproval"></a>`FnApproval`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/approvals.ts`

A fn whose every run waits for approval (`FnDecl.approval`). `preview`: the hub asks the system for a preview first.
`remember`: whether the person may say "don't ask again" for it (never for writes and schema changes).

```ts
type FnApproval = {
  preview: boolean;
  remember: boolean;
  approver?: "person" | "admins" | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-pairinggrant"></a>`PairingGrant`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/approvals.ts`

The token (shown once, valid for one hello with the subject's name, instance and manifest hash) and when it lapses.

```ts
type PairingGrant = {
  token: string;
  expiresAt: number;
};
```

#### <a id="core-pairinggrantrequest"></a>`PairingGrantRequest`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/approvals.ts`

An approved install run asks the hub for a one-time pairing token bound to its subject (`grantPairing`).

```ts
type PairingGrantRequest = {
  run: string;
  subject: {
    kind: "system-install";
    system: SystemName;
    instance: InstanceName;
    version: string;
    manifestHash: string;
    bundleHash: string;
    sourceHash: string;
    host: {
      system: SystemName;
      instance: InstanceName;
    };
    source?: string | undefined;
    grants?: {
      hub: ("search" | "embed" | "fns" | "settings" | "state" | "resources" | "approvals" | "connections" | "data" | "ai" | "decide")[];
      models?: {
        roles?: ("ocr" | "chat" | "transcribe" | "dictate" | "speak" | "describe")[] | undefined;
        models?: string[] | undefined;
        perRun?: number | undefined;
        perDay?: number | undefined;
      } | undefined;
      secrets?: string[] | undefined;
      calls?: (`${string}/${string}` | SystemName)[] | undefined;
      network?: string[] | undefined;
      files?: {
        read: string[];
        write: string[];
      } | undefined;
    } | undefined;
    replaces?: {
      version: string;
      manifestHash: string;
    } | undefined;
  };
};
```

#### <a id="core-proposalapprover"></a>`ProposalApprover`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/approvals.ts`

Who answers a proposed run or a fn that always asks: the run's person, or an admin (only an admin's decision counts).

```ts
type ProposalApprover = "person" | "admins";
```
